rows.name: Financial Performance Overview Dashboard
rows.description: Management-ready financial performance view with KPI scorecards, trends and cost intelligence. Gain a clear, consolidated view of financial performance across revenue, profitability, cash, margins and cost drivers in one interactive dashboard. Designed for finance leaders and executives to monitor results, identify variances and act with confidence.
